name: T10 Ultra Smartwatch
subtitle: Large display with Bluetooth calling
description: T10 Ultra is a smartwatch with a 2.09-inch full-touch display, Bluetooth calling, activity tracking and smart notifications. It supports heart rate and sleep tracking, multiple sports modes, and Android and iOS compatibility, with a black silicone strap for everyday wear.
story: Designed for users who want core smartwatch functions in a familiar rectangular format, the T10 Ultra combines calling, notifications and everyday activity tracking on the wrist. Its large full-touch display provides space for watch faces, menus and alerts, while Bluetooth pairing connects it with compatible smartphones. Multiple sports modes support different activities, and basic wellness tools track heart rate and sleep. Battery life is rated for up to five to seven days under typical usage, depending on settings and features used.

specs.water_resistance: Splash & sweat resistant; IP rating may vary

shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
